content.comment_body: Hello, I installed the latest version of [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 10, but now I can't access the parameters for the Pulse Relay. Additionally, the menu text appears extremely small. Does anyone have a solution? Thanks, [user_name].
Welcome to the forum. I haven't encountered this issue before. Did you install [product_name] with administrator rights? If not, consider uninstalling it and reinstalling as an administrator.

Try the following steps: right-click the [product_name] executable, go to properties, open the compatibility tab, and check the box to disable or override display scaling on high DPI settings. Choose scaling performed by Application or System.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report missing parameter access for the Pulse Relay feature when using [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 10. There is also an issue with extremely small menu text. Suggestions include checking administrative rights and adjusting compatibility display scaling settings.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to view all configuration parameters for the Pulse Relay and have clear, readable menu text in [product_name].
